input: Create a personalized workout split for the next cycle

gold.taskTitle: Create a Personalized Workout Split for Next Cycle
gold.taskDescription: Design a tailored workout split plan structured around the user's fitness level, goals, schedule, and available resources for their upcoming training cycle.

questions.title: What is your primary fitness goal right now?
questions.description: Understand whether the user is training for muscle gain, fat loss, strength, endurance, athleticism, or general fitness.

questions.title: How many days per week can you train?
questions.description: Determine the number of available training days to structure the split appropriately (e.g., 3-day, 4-day, 5-day split).

questions.title: How long is each session you can commit to?
questions.description: Find out the duration per workout session in minutes to ensure the plan is realistic and executable.

questions.title: What equipment or gym setup do you have access to?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user trains at a fully equipped gym, a home gym, with dumbbells only, or bodyweight, as this shapes exercise selection.

questions.title: What is your current training experience level?
questions.description: Identify whether the user is a beginner, intermediate, or advanced lifter to calibrate volume, intensity, and complexity.

questions.title: Do you have any injuries or physical limitations currently?
questions.description: Uncover any movement restrictions, pain points, or areas to avoid so the plan is safe and appropriate.

questions.title: How long is the training cycle you are planning for?
questions.description: Establish the intended duration of the cycle (e.g., 4 weeks, 6 weeks, 8 weeks) to structure progression and periodization properly.
